summary: Combines the assigned resource readiness states into the defined site availability display.
description: Combines the assigned resource readiness states into the defined site availability display. Microgrid supervision coordinates measurements, control authority and resource communication without replacing local protection. Each resource value needs a named measurement boundary, freshness condition and intended control use.

In a microgrid control room, the operator can see source availability, active constraints and current operating mode. A communication failure should remain distinguishable from an electrical resource failure. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Resource readiness and topology” at the input and “Site resource availability” at the output. Available resources can have different operating capabilities.
